# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

Conventions: releases use `vX.Y.Z` for stable and `vX.Y.Z-rc.N` for automated
prereleases cut from each merge to `main`. Commit messages follow
[Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) so the changelog
groupings and GitHub-generated release notes stay meaningful.
